highFindingDisposition: Same existing severity7.5 SHA-1 Windows/CryptoPro certificate-store identifier at reader line71. Reader is byte-identical to scanned e774; only helper visibility changed relative026/166. No new SHA-1 call; this is not the CMS signing algorithm, password hashing or updater integrity. Java gate remains FAILED; no query, threshold, suppression or security gate was weakened.

manualGuardReview.scope: Six Java certificate-related files plus four localized warning-resource files differ from026; guard adds repository predicate visibility and UI confirmation on top of e774. Source review is separate from actual seller/token acceptance.
facts: Repository signerChanged changes only from private to public with documentation; predicate body, owner/resetSQL, transaction/CAS/active-work checks and schema remain unchanged.
Before submitting the first local signing/auth task, UI checks the exact repository signer-change predicate and obtains explicit modal confirmation; cancellation exits before the task is submitted.
After modal confirmation, UI rejects changed shop, repository,loaded/candidate/persisted settings, running work or expired selection. Lookup errors show a sanitized error and exit before signing.
Default confirmation and task executor remain actual production functions; package-private injection methods support synthetic UI tests only.
Discovery/public-DER binding, private-key and CMS identity verification, owner/INN and signing no-retry/deadline controls remain unchanged from e774.
Four locale files add only three explanatory warning keys each; they describe existing catalog/mapping/KIZ reset consequences.

conditionalFinding.condition: Selected full thumbprintB has inconsistent discovery metadata.thumbprintM equal to previous certificateM.
conditionalFinding.counterexample: Expected selectorM/metadataM; candidate selectorB/metadataM. Preview signerChanged returnsfalse from equal metadata. Actual CMS thumbprintB passes selectedB verification, recovery writes metadataB, and final signerChanged returns true before reset.
conditionalFinding.evidence: Static source control-flow counterexample; not executed against a real device or seller profile. CAdES DER-bound discovery prevents this inconsistency for its own records, while legacy certmgr parsing allows explicit selector separate from thumbprint.
conditionalFinding.impact: Under this malformed-public-metadata condition the existing reset may happen without the new confirmation.
conditionalFinding.suggestion: Conservatively reject or confirm inconsistent full thumbprint selection before signing; also fail closed before authentication/persistence if verified signer-change is true but confirmation was absent.
conditionalFinding.disposition: Retriaged as non-actionable for current production: no normal producer of the mismatched record was found. This synthetic/corrupted-metadata counterexample remains documented; no runtime change or rerun is recommended from it alone.
producerInvariants: Certmgr parser flushes a record before a second selector-like field. Selector/id and thumbprint keys share that boundary set; explicitB plus thumbprintM produces B/blank and M/M, not B/M.
CAdES discovery and actualCMS constructors bind selector to the validated public DER fingerprint.
preserveVerifiedCertificateMetadata restores the configured selector when a discovered fingerprint matches the actual verified certificate.

Normal UI selection, draft and signature-success paths write selector and metadata together. The counterexample required arbitrary test injection or external/corrupted legacy data with no demonstrated current producer.

supersededProvenance: The2a5 final-source-provenance record is historical only. UI, repository and four resources changed, so runtime identity to e774 cannot be reused; this review uses an actual fresh guard-source scan.
